sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:7

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:7:1
items.html: (14) The lower ones have no strength to receive these lights that come out through the Nikvey Einayim: For the reflected light that emerges upon the discernment of the coarseness of phase one is a thin light that does not reach the discernment of a Guf [body], that is, clothing, as was explained above in the preceding parts. You also know that the Einayim are an appellation for the Sefira of Hochma of the Rosh [head], which is phase one. And this is what he says, that there was as yet no strength or ability to receive the lights of the Nikvey Einayim.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:7:2
items.html: Another, second restriction in AK, after the manner of the restriction mentioned above in Ein Sof. This is seemingly puzzling: in the two preceding Partzufim, too, there was that same departure of the lights from the Guf of the upper one in order to emanate to the lower one, which are called above, in the words of the ARI, the first departure and the second departure. See the end of Part 5, item 60. So how is this departure of the NHY of AK different, that he should call it by the name “the second restriction,” and moreover liken it to the first restriction of the worlds? The matter is that in truth an entirely new thing took place here, apart from the sense of the departure of the light that occurred in AB and Galgalta of AK. And it is that a new discernment of a point of restriction was made here, in addition to the first point of restriction that came about in the restriction of Ein Sof. And this came about by reason of the mingling of the records of SAG and the records of phase four with one another, as above in the Inner Light, page 396, the passage beginning “MA and BON.” Study it there well. Therefore the place of the restriction, which had been at the Sium of phase four, which is the point of this world, was raised, and it has now been raised to the place of the Sium of phase two, which is the discernment of (15) the Tabur of the world of Nekudim, as will be written further on. Thus the ascent of the lights of NHY to the HGT of AK caused a new point of restriction and a new Sium for the worlds, entirely similar to the first restriction that took place in Ein Sof, in the words of the ARI. Know also that from the place of the new point of restriction, which is the Tabur of Nekudim, to the place of the first point of restriction, which is this world, is the place where the three worlds below Atzilut, called BYA, stand, as will be further written in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:7:3
items.html:
All the light that expanded inside the internality of this AK from the place of his Tabur downward, He raised above the place of the Tabur. It has already been explained that the ARI speaks here of two Partzufim: the first Partzuf of AK, called the inner AK, in which the coarseness of phase four operates; and the third Partzuf of AK, called SAG, in which the coarseness of phase two operates, as written in the Inner Light above, page 390, the passage beginning “And SAG.” Study it there well, for it is impossible to repeat that lengthy discussion here. And Tabur means the place of the Sium of the feet of the second expansion of AK, which is called AB. This is for the reason explained there: that this AB has only a screen of phase three, and therefore it cannot shine below the Tabur of the inner AK, where the place of the vessels of phase four is, since AB has no discernment of a screen of phase four; it is therefore regarded as ending at the Tabur, and the vessels of the inner AK remained empty, without light, from his Tabur downward, just as they had been at the time of the first departure, before AB expanded. However, after the third Partzuf, called SAG, expanded, its discernments of Nekudot expanded — which are its nine lower Sefirot, in which there is only the light of Bina, as above — and they clothed and filled the empty vessels from the Tabur downward of the inner AK, as written there. Thus these lights that are from the Tabur downward of AK are the discernments of two Partzufim: the inner AK and the SAG of AK; for the nine lower ones of SAG are clothed in half of Tifferet and the NHY of the inner AK, that is, in his place from the Tabur downward.
And this is what he says: “all the light that expanded inside the internality of this AK from his Tabur downward” — that is, the two kinds of lights mentioned above, which are the nine lower ones of SAG and the ZON of phase four of the inner AK itself. “He raised it above the place of the Tabur, into the upper half of his Guf” — that is, these two kinds of lights departed from this place below the Tabur, which are called TNHY, and rose above the point of the Tabur, to the Taamim of SAG, as above in the Inner Light (page 397, the passage beginning “The MAN,” and the passage beginning “Couple.” Study it there well).

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:7:4
items.html:
He raised it above the place of the Tabur. This ascent of the lights from below the Tabur of AK to the place above the Tabur is the most fundamental matter in this wisdom, and it must therefore be well understood. It is in truth a very lengthy matter, which is explained only through the understanding of all the discourses of the ARI on the emanation of Nekudim. However, the essential axis of it is the matter of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, which is the joining of phase two, which is the secret of Bina, with phase four, which is the secret of Malchut. This is the secret of what is brought in the Zohar, Ruth, on the verse “and they two went,” that the two Heys in the name HaVaYaH — namely the first Hey, which is Bina, and the bottom Hey, which is Malchut — joined and became as one. And this matter was rooted here, in the ascents of the lights of the NHY of AK that are below the Tabur to the HGT that are above the Tabur. For at first the light of the nine lower ones of SAG, which are phase two, expanded below the Tabur of AK, and they clothed and joined with the ZON of phase four that are there; and through this phase four received the strength to be able afterwards to rise, together with the nine lower ones of SAG, above the Tabur, where the discernment of the Taamim of SAG is — that is, the direct light of mercy of the expansion of SAG — and from there to the Hochma of the Rosh of SAG, which is called the Nikvey Einayim. Thus phase four, which is the secret of the bottom Hey, clothed and came into the screen in the Nikvey Einayim, and was included there in the upper coupling upon this screen, which raises reflected light from Hochma to Keter and draws a level of phase one, which is the level of ZA, as is known. But since there is also there the discernment of clothing of phase two, as will be written further on, it is therefore regarded as the level of Israel Saba and Tevuna. It turns out that in this YESHSUT, which emerges from the coupling of the Einayim, phase four is included, which is the bottom Hey of HaVaYaH; so that the two discernments — the quality of mercy, which is the discernment of YESHSUT, and the quality of judgment, which is the discernment of the bottom Hey — joined here into one actual Partzuf.
And you find that this whole joining and association of phase two and phase four came about through the ascents of the lights of the NHY of AK to his HGT above the Tabur. For from there phase two and phase four rose, included in one another, until they came together to the place of the coupling with the upper light, called the Nikvey Einayim, and the two of them became one actual Partzuf; and this is the Partzuf called the world of Nekudim. Remember this understanding, for it is the foundation of all the discourses that follow. And the particulars of the above matter, and the cause of the departure of the lights of NHY, have already been explained above, page 395, the passage beginning “All the discernments … rose.”
